newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rojo asks for greater deficit effort - press.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rojo asks for greater deficit effort - press.

text.p: Bank of Spain governor Luis Angel Rojo called for greater efforts to reduce the public deficit, local media reported on Friday.
Speaking at a seminar in the city of San Sebastian, Rojo showed he was opposed to relaxing the convergence criteria for European economic and monetary union, or the timetable.
"It would be a grave error to back a delay or a relaxation because this would damage the credibility of the process," Rojo said.
